chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 03 (Unit 12: Geometrical Optics)
subject: physics-10

questions.question: Which of the following optical phenomena occurs in the transmission of light through an optical fiber?
questions.explanation: Optical fibers guide light pulses via successive total internal reflections occurring whenever the angle of incidence exceeds the critical angle.

questions.question: An object is placed at 12 cm in front of a mirror, forming a virtual image 6 cm behind the mirror. The focal length of the mirror is:
questions.explanation: Using 1/f = 1/p + 1/q with p = +12 cm and virtual image q = -6 cm: 1/f = 1/12 - 1/6 = -1/12, giving f = -12 cm (a convex mirror).

questions.question: The SI unit of the optical power of a lens is:
questions.explanation: Optical power P = 1/f (with focal length f in meters) is measured in dioptres (D), where 1 D = 1 m⁻¹.

questions.question: A natural rainbow formed in the sky after rain is primarily due to:
questions.explanation: Sunlight entering spherical raindrops undergoes refraction, dispersion into component colors, internal reflection, and final refraction.

questions.question: The focal length of a convex mirror with a radius of curvature of 10 cm is:
questions.explanation: For a convex mirror, focal length is negative and equals half the radius of curvature: f = -R/2 = -10/2 = -5 cm.

questions.question: The refractive index of ordinary crown glass is approximately:
questions.explanation: Crown glass has a refractive index n ≈ 1.50–1.52, while water is 1.33, vacuum is 1.00, and diamond is 2.42.

questions.question: In the human eye, light rays converge to form a real, inverted image on the:
questions.explanation: The cornea and crystalline lens focus incident light onto the light-sensitive retina lining the back of the eye.

questions.question: An endoscopic instrument specifically designed to view inside the stomach is called a/an:
questions.explanation: A gastroscope is a specialized optical fiber endoscope inserted through the mouth to examine the esophagus, stomach, and duodenum.

questions.question: The inner high-refractive-index cylinder of an optical fiber is called the:
questions.explanation: An optical fiber consists of an inner core (higher refractive index n₁) surrounded by an outer cladding (lower refractive index n₂).

An object is placed exactly at the centre of curvature (2F) of a concave mirror. The image produced is located:
questions.explanation: When an object is placed at the centre of curvature (C = 2F), the reflected rays form a real, inverted image of the same size at C.

questions.question: According to the first law of reflection, if the angle of incidence is 30°, the angle of reflection will be:
questions.explanation: The law of reflection states that angle of incidence equals angle of reflection (∠i = ∠r = 30°).
